■Direction Note
Start talking cheerfully and familiarly, feeling like comrades

■Direction Note

■Direction Note
・Daring Heart = Pronunciation sample available

Hehe, right now I'm bulking up—it's my bulking phase.
All to sculpt this body to perfection for the mock race, you see.

Piled on her plate was far too much food for her petite frame.
She seemed to be trying to force it down through sheer willpower alone.

You really know how to assess a situation calmly—
Hehe, so you actually are an excellent Trainer after all. ...Oh, right, who's your trainee?

Watching the Japanese Triple Tiara races...
I made a solemn vow. That I, too, would wear that crown of flowers!
(......You're right....... I didn't even notice—......)

So with that said, I'll be sticking to solo lunches for a while.
Once things settle down, let's have lunch together again♪

Well, this seems like a good place to stop.
You're such a good listener... I ended up getting carried away!

Of course, Dearing Heart had talent as well.
Even so, if there was one area where she fell just a step short of them—

A few days had passed since meeting Dearing Heart...
Before I knew it, my eyes were constantly following her every move.

...Soon, I'll be running a mock race against my peers aiming for the Tiara route.
It's our debut stage where fateful rivals gather. —Which is all the more reason why.

Ah... my schedule? Heheh, you really are a worrywart, aren't you?
Don't worry, I'm plenty tough♪

I'm heading straight outside for a run.
Sorry to trouble you, but could you hand me my bag?
I can do this...... I can still keep going...

That's right... Your career as a Trainer, my journey to becoming Queen,
it's all just beginning. Ah... it's so exciting!

I'm sure you'll make a wonderful Trainer.
Because you're so kind. Almost... too kind for me.

An unyielding, razor-sharp conviction
drove her endlessly forward.

The Triple Tiara—a title bestowed only upon those who conquer all three Classic-tier
races: the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba (Oaks), and the Shuka Sho.
And without fail, I will become the Queen of the Triple Tiara—!

The weights she held were heavier than I could have imagined.
She was subjecting herself to a load unthinkable for her frame.

I was hoping to see you again!
Would you like to hang out after this? There's something I'd love to ask of you♪

"Please let me know if you notice anything"—
At her request, I ended up watching over her training session.

Is that so? Still... I see, how unexpected.
So you're just getting started, too.

Her form was beginning to falter slightly; continuing like this would yield no real benefit.
Worse yet, she risked injury. Unable to watch any longer, I called out to her.

............I understand.
I guess I was pushing myself too hard... Thanks for pointing it out.

A mock race... against Line Craft and the others?!
I heard they're crazy strong~! But for you, Heart, it'll be a breeze, right?♪
Yes. What I'm aiming for is the Triple Tiara.

Disadvantages, reckless odds—I'll overpower them all.
I will hone my "Daring Heart" and seize victory!

No. Craft, Cesario, Messiah...
They all possess magnificent talent. They won't be easy opponents... not in the slightest.

She was strong. Her heart, her gaze, her conviction.
For an Umamusume this formidable... perhaps my help wasn't needed at all.

There was simply too little breathing room.
If she kept this up, would her body... her mind, really be all right?

Heart's having lunch all by herself again!
...Whoa! Aren't you eating even more than before...?!?
.Ugh.so much.

..., ...Phew... Finished it all.
——...Oh? Hey!

To become the "absolute best version of myself,"
I can't afford to stand still. ...Not even for a single second.

If something like that were to happen,
and cloud that noble "Daring Heart"—

Her schedule had zero margin of error.
She was shaving every spare moment down to the limit—which meant shaving away at herself.

As I moved to hand her the bag,
her open planner caught my eye.

Where I fall short—is physique.
To come out on top in a battle of wills, building physical strength is crucial.

What if one day... that tautly drawn string
were to suddenly snap...?

Line Craft, Cesario, Air Messiah—
Formidable Umamusume who, like Dearing Heart, aimed for the Tiara route.

What she spoke of wasn't just a dream... but an approaching future.
—Her fierce spirit stirred my soul deeply.

Train for even one second longer, gain even one more gram of muscle.
My diet, my daily life—I will devote every single piece of it to victory!

—All for the sake of winning. If I want to be ahead of everyone else, I must outwork everyone else.
Relentless, unbreakable—even if I have to crawl, I'll keep moving forward.
...? Is something wrong?

To achieve that, I must clash with Heart head-on.
—Equipped with a weapon of my own.

No, I can still... keep going...! 
Just about two more sets...!
